subject: biochemistry
intro: Biochemistry is the mole-level chemistry of life, and it feeds the laboratories that design medicines, diagnose disease, read genomes and understand how metabolism works and breaks.

roles.title: Biochemists and Biophysicists
roles.what: Study the chemical basis of living things: how proteins fold, how enzymes catalyse reactions and how cells convert food into energy. They test how foods, drugs, serums and hormones act on tissues, and push research on metabolism, reproduction, growth and heredity.
roles.where: Every unit is the toolkit: protein structure and folding, Michaelis–Menten enzyme kinetics, glycolysis and the TCA cycle, allosteric haemoglobin, and the chromatography, electrophoresis and mass-spectrometry methods from unit 9.

roles.title: Medical Scientists, Except Epidemiologists
roles.what: Research human diseases and the improvement of human health, running clinical investigations and research-and-development programmes that turn an understanding of disease mechanisms into new tests and treatments.
roles.where: The metabolic-regulation unit — hormonal control, fed and fasting states, metabolic disorders — plus protein misfolding diseases and the nucleic-acid methods unit give you the disease-mechanism vocabulary clinical research is built on.

roles.title: Biological Technicians
roles.what: Assist biological and medical scientists: set up and maintain laboratory instruments, monitor experiments, collect samples and data, and record and calculate results, sometimes analysing organic substances such as blood, food and drugs.
roles.where: Unit 9's biochemical methods — chromatography, electrophoresis, mass spectrometry and metabolomics — are exactly the bench skills labs hire for, and the enzyme and metabolism units teach the assays you would run.

roles.title: Natural Sciences Managers
roles.what: Plan, direct and coordinate activities in the life and physical sciences and in research and development, supervising laboratory teams, budgets and timelines so that discovery programmes actually deliver.
roles.where: A biochemistry degree supplies the scientific judgement managers need to evaluate experiments — from reaction kinetics to metabolic pathways — and the integration unit's systems view maps onto coordinating whole programmes.
